value.title: Il computer impazzito
value.synopsis: Eleanor City's landmark tower "Damocles Tower". The self-sustaining main computer that manages it rebelled against humans. Being sown by fire and water, they are attacked by a group of mechas who lose control and run away, and the inhabitants just run away. Among such people, Kay and Yuri of WWWA's trouble consultant "Lovely Angel" appeared ...

value.title: Sabotaggio
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri investigate sabotage on the maiden voyage of a luxury space liner, with an older man who may or may not have chest hair.

value.title: Il furto della moneta
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair must retrieve a gambling chip stolen from a museum.

value.title: Un gatto prezioso
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair investigate the disappearance of a cat from the Bio-Genetics Lab.

value.title: Ordine di esecuzione
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri are beleaguered and then abducted by an abandoned space station created by a mad scientist, and only little robot Nammo can save them.

value.title: Un carico pericoloso
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri must defend a precious stone prism shipment against pirates.

value.title: Il rapimento
value.synopsis: The heir to a travel empire elopes on his wedding day, but his new love tries to extort a ransom from his father. A variety of plot twists ensue.

value.title: Una vecchia promessa
value.synopsis: Yuri's childhood sweetheart contacts her, but he may be in trouble.

value.title: Due bande rivali
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri are stranded on a Wild West themed frontier planet and run into the local protection racket, which they offer to protect.

value.title: Proteggete il principe!
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair go to planet Caspia to ensure the security of the young royal successor and prevent the throne being usurped by a wicked uncle.

value.title: Un appuntamento a sorpresa
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair have a week off and are invited to a party, but are mistaken for fugitives when they go shopping for dresses.

value.title: La rivolta dei topi
value.synopsis: 3WA headquarters is sealed off following the theft of an R&D security system, and suffers a rodent infestation.

value.title: Il mostro del sottosuolo
value.synopsis: Dangerous acid-spewing life forms have taken over the sewage facility.

value.title: Pandora
value.synopsis: A presidential candidate is targeted for having his past erased, and it's time for annual maintenance of the Pandora's Box security system.

value.title: Un antico tesoro
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair meet an old cowboy who takes them treasure hunting.

value.title: Giochi politici
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri are hired to escort the naive teenage chairman of an important company who wants to see the city, but lose her at the first opportunity.

value.title: Il buco nero
value.synopsis: 3WA's best agent has been assassinated, and the Dirty Pair must find out which of the passengers on a spaceflight is the perpetrator.

value.title: Servizio di scorta
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair arrest a difficult character, but getting him to the police station is even more complicated.

value.title: Uno strano incarico
value.synopsis: Kei and Yuri are sent to avenge the "murder" of an eccentric millionaire's romantic interest, a doll. It's going to be tricky though as they already know who dropped a space pod on the doll's head.

value.title: Vendetta!
value.synopsis: The Dirty Pair are looking for an assassin who has gone to ground. Unfortunately they end up owing him a favour.

value.title: Il mistero dei passeggeri scomparsi
value.synopsis: A passenger spaceship on a routine flight arrives in port with nobody aboard.

value.title: Il ricatto
value.synopsis: Arthur admits his part in the disappearance mystery, but his plan has been hijacked by the pilots to their own ends.

value.title: La truffa
value.synopsis: Yuri is injured when the 3WA pull them off a drugs job at the last moment, but is helped by a charming con man.

value.title: Il maniaco omicida
value.synopsis: A door-to-door salesman serial killer is on the loose, and the Dirty Pair are assigned to be a honeypot to catch him.

value.title: Denaro Falso
value.synopsis: Yuri is on a date, so when a job comes up Kei has to partner with Calico to intercept a counterfeiter.

value.title: Il grande cannone
value.synopsis: Chief Gooley inspects the 3WA Weapons Lab, but Marcus has taken over and executed everyone. Gooley is taken hostage and the city is held to ransom with Marcus's God Cannon.
